notes: Original Doc Shorthand: Make a fried egg throw on furikake — Or make a omelette or scramble — 3 large eggs — 1 tablespoon soy sauce — 1 tablespoon mirin (sweet rice wine) — 1 tablespoon vegetable oil — 2 green onions, finely chopped — Salt and pepper to taste — Furikake — Mix mirin, eggs — Sautee green onions in a little oil — Mix soy sauce, salt, and pepper to eggs, pour in,.scramble or omelette — Top with furikkake
